data.title: Block (XYZ) Stock May Be 19% Undervalued On Bitcoin Payments Rollout
data.description: Block stock has delivered a decline of 69.1% over the past five years, yet the latest intrinsic value work using an Excess Returns model points to meaningful upside while traditional earnings multiples flag the shares as expensive. This leaves investors with a split valuation picture. Over five years, Block shareholders have seen the stock fall 69.1%. Any case for upside now relies heavily on how today’s valuation links to future cash generation rather than past returns. New developments...
